from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

CASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W, H, N = 256, 160, 20
SS = 4


def smoothstep(t):
    t = float(np.clip(t, 0.0, 1.0))
    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)


def lerp(a, b, t):
    t = smoothstep(t)
    return (a[0] * (1-t) + b[0] * t, a[1] * (1-t) + b[1] * t)


def ik_elbow(shoulder, wrist, l1=78.0, l2=72.0):
    """Stable lower-elbow solution for the fixed two-link right arm."""
    sx, sy = shoulder
    wx, wy = wrist
    dx, dy = wx-sx, wy-sy
    d = max(1e-5, math.hypot(dx, dy))
    dsolve = min(max(d, abs(l1-l2)+0.1), l1+l2-0.1)
    ux, uy = dx/d, dy/d
    a = (l1*l1 - l2*l2 + dsolve*dsolve) / (2*dsolve)
    h = math.sqrt(max(0.0, l1*l1 - a*a))
    px, py = sx + a*ux, sy + a*uy
    # subtract the normal: selects the downward, workspace-side elbow.
    return (px + uy*h, py - ux*h)


def Spt(p):
    return tuple(int(round(v*SS)) for v in p)


def draw_line(draw, points, fill, width, joint="curve"):
    draw.line([Spt(p) for p in points], fill=fill, width=max(1, int(width*SS)), joint=joint)

    elbow = ik_elbow(shoulder, wrist)
    lay = Image.new("RGBA", (W*SS, H*SS), (0,0,0,0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(lay)

    # Soft cast shadow gives contact with the warm work surface.
    shadow = Image.new("RGBA", lay.size, (0,0,0,0))
    sd = ImageDraw.Draw(shadow)
    sh_pts = [(shoulder[0]+2, shoulder[1]+4), (elbow[0]+2, elbow[1]+4), (wrist[0]+2, wrist[1]+4)]
    draw_line(sd, sh_pts[:2], (8,6,4,65), 19)
    draw_line(sd, sh_pts[1:], (8,6,4,65), 16)
    shadow = shadow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(2.2*SS))
    lay.alpha_composite(shadow)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(lay)

    # Black edge, warm-gray shell, and narrow fixed highlights: all move rigidly.
    draw_line(d, [shoulder, elbow], (20,21,20,255), 19)
    draw_line(d, [shoulder, elbow], (70,73,68,255), 15)
    draw_line(d, [shoulder, elbow], (113,115,106,220), 7)
    draw_line(d, [shoulder, elbow], (147,146,132,170), 2)

    draw_line(d, [elbow, wrist], (17,18,18,255), 16)
    draw_line(d, [elbow, wrist], (62,66,64,255), 12)
    draw_line(d, [elbow, wrist], (105,109,103,230), 5)
    draw_line(d, [elbow, wrist], (143,143,131,160), 1.5)

    # A fixed routing cable reinforces the mechanical, non-deforming construction.
    vx, vy = wrist[0]-elbow[0], wrist[1]-elbow[1]
    mag = max(1.0, math.hypot(vx,vy)); nx, ny = -vy/mag, vx/mag
    cable = [(elbow[0]+nx*7, elbow[1]+ny*7), (wrist[0]+nx*6, wrist[1]+ny*6)]
    draw_line(d, cable, (11,12,12,245), 2.2)

    for c, r in [(shoulder,11), (elbow,10), (wrist,7)]:
        x,y=Spt(c); rr=int(r*SS)
        d.ellipse((x-rr,y-rr,x+rr,y+rr), fill=(24,26,25,255), outline=(8,9,9,255), width=SS)
        rr2=int((r-3)*SS)
        d.ellipse((x-rr2,y-rr2,x+rr2,y+rr2), fill=(96,99,92,255), outline=(138,137,124,230), width=SS)
        rb=max(1,int(2.0*SS))

    # Vertical wrist motor and parallel-jaw palm.
    wx, wy = wrist
    d.rounded_rectangle((int((wx-7)*SS),int((wy-1)*SS),int((wx+7)*SS),int((wy+10)*SS)),
                        radius=3*SS, fill=(32,34,33,255), outline=(9,10,10,255), width=SS)
    d.rounded_rectangle((int((wx-15)*SS),int((wy+7)*SS),int((wx+15)*SS),int((wy+14)*SS)),
                        radius=2*SS, fill=(69,72,68,255), outline=(14,15,15,255), width=SS)
    # Tiny actuator face / status light.
    d.ellipse((int((wx-2)*SS),int((wy+2)*SS),int((wx+2)*SS),int((wy+6)*SS)), fill=(112,123,66,255))
    return lay


def finger_layer(wrist, opening):

    lay = Image.new("RGBA", (W*SS,H*SS), (0,0,0,0))

    # Maintain the flat rim and softly antialiased glass edge.

    mask = mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(0.45*SS)).resize(patch.size,Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    patch.putalpha(mask)
    return patch, (x0,y0), np.asarray(mask)

    base=Image.fromarray(frame,"RGB").convert("RGBA")

        op=12.2

        op=12.2

    elif i == 18:

    else:

        glass_center=None

    return out

def smoothstep(t):
    t = float(np.clip(t, 0.0, 1.0))
    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)


def lerp(a, b, t):
    t = smoothstep(t)
    return (a[0] * (1-t) + b[0] * t, a[1] * (1-t) + b[1] * t)


def ik_elbow(shoulder, wrist, l1=78.0, l2=72.0):
    \"\"\"Stable lower-elbow solution for the fixed two-link right arm.\"\"\"
    sx, sy = shoulder
    wx, wy = wrist
    dx, dy = wx-sx, wy-sy
    d = max(1e-5, math.hypot(dx, dy))
    dsolve = min(max(d, abs(l1-l2)+0.1), l1+l2-0.1)
    ux, uy = dx/d, dy/d
    a = (l1*l1 - l2*l2 + dsolve*dsolve) / (2*dsolve)
    h = math.sqrt(max(0.0, l1*l1 - a*a))
    px, py = sx + a*ux, sy + a*uy
    # subtract the normal: selects the downward, workspace-side elbow.
    return (px + uy*h, py - ux*h)

    \"\"\"Use source RGB exactly inside a feathered silhouette of the existing olive glass.\"\"\"
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = 132,72,161,113
    patch = Image.fromarray(src[y0:y1,x0:x1], \"RGB\").convert(\"RGBA\")
    mask = Image.new(\"L\", ((x1-x0)*SS,(y1-y0)*SS), 0)
    md = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    poly=[(9,4),(18,4),(23,10),(23,30),(19,36),(9,36),(5,30),(5,10)]
    md.polygon([Spt(p) for p in poly], fill=255)
    # Maintain the flat rim and softly antialiased glass edge.
    md.ellipse((5*SS,3*SS,23*SS,11*SS),fill=255)
    mask = mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(0.45*SS)).resize(patch.size,Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    patch.putalpha(mask)
    return patch, (x0,y0), np.asarray(mask)


def paste_glass(frame, sprite, src_origin, center):
    # Original glass center was approximately (146,92).
    dx=int(round(center[0]-146)); dy=int(round(center[1]-92))
    base=Image.fromarray(frame,\"RGB\").convert(\"RGBA\")
    base.alpha_composite(sprite, (src_origin[0]+dx,src_origin[1]+dy))
    return np.asarray(base.convert(\"RGB\"),dtype=np.uint8)


def wrist_and_opening(i):
    if i <= 4:                       # deliberate approach, jaws open
        w=lerp((188,58),(146,62),i/4)
        op=16.5
    elif i == 5:                    # close around the glass
        w=(146,62); op=12.2
    elif i <= 8:                    # lift vertically before translating
        w=lerp((146,62),(146,34),(i-5)/3)
        op=12.2
    elif i <= 13:                   # level transfer above basket
        t=(i-8)/5
        w=lerp((146,34),(100,33),t)
        # slight safe upward arc in the middle
        w=(w[0],w[1]-3.0*math.sin(math.pi*np.clip(t,0,1)))
        op=12.2
    elif i <= 16:                   # lower into basket
        w=lerp((100,33),(100,74),(i-13)/3)
        op=12.2
    elif i == 17:                   # release without disturbing placed object
        w=(100,74); op=17.0
    elif i == 18:
        w=lerp((100,74),(128,40),0.72); op=17.0
    else:
        w=(166,43); op=17.0
    return w,op


def make_background(src):
    # Numerically remove only the original glass; all of the fixed workspace remains.
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
    poly=np.array([[139,75],[152,75],[157,82],[156,104],[151,110],[138,110],[134,103],[135,82]],np.int32)
    cv2.fillPoly(m,[poly],255)
    m=cv2.dilate(m,np.ones((5,5),np.uint8),iterations=1)
    return cv2.inpaint(src,m,4,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)


def add_contact_shadow(frame, center, strength):
    if strength <= 0: return frame
    lay=Image.new(\"RGBA\",(W*SS,H*SS),(0,0,0,0));d=ImageDraw.Draw(lay)
    cx,cy=center
    d.ellipse((int((cx-12)*SS),int((cy+15)*SS),int((cx+12)*SS),int((cy+21)*SS)),fill=(10,7,4,int(75*strength)))
    lay=lay.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(2.5*SS))
    return alpha_over(frame,lay)


def basket_foreground(frame, src, amount):
    \"\"\"Restore photographed weave in front of the inserted glass/gripper.\"\"\"
    if amount <= 0: return frame
    fg=Image.fromarray(src,\"RGB\").convert(\"RGBA\")
    mask=Image.new(\"L\",(W,H),0); d=ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    # Rectangular woven face, subtly tapered by perspective; top edge is the front rim.
    d.polygon([(77,101),(121,101),(123,153),(73,153)],fill=int(255*amount))
    mask=mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(0.7))
    fg.putalpha(mask)
    base=Image.fromarray(frame,\"RGB\").convert(\"RGBA\");base.alpha_composite(fg)
    return np.asarray(base.convert(\"RGB\"),dtype=np.uint8)


def generate():
    src=np.asarray(Image.open(CASE_DIR/\"first_frame.png\").convert(\"RGB\"),dtype=np.uint8)
    assert src.shape==(H,W,3)
    clean=make_background(src)
    sprite,origin,_=make_glass_sprite(src)
    frames=[]
    for i in range(N):
        if i==0:
            frames.append(src.copy())
            continue
        # Keep photographed glass untouched through closing; clean it once lift begins.
        frame=(src.copy() if i<=5 else clean.copy())
        wrist,opening=wrist_and_opening(i)
        # Ground shadow of glass fades during lift; basket contact shadow returns on lowering.
        if 6<=i<=8:
            c=(wrist[0],wrist[1]+30)
            frame=add_contact_shadow(frame,(146,92),max(0,1-(i-5)/3))
        elif 14<=i<=17:
            c=(wrist[0],wrist[1]+30)
            frame=add_contact_shadow(frame,c,(i-13)/4)
        frame=alpha_over(frame,arm_body_layer(wrist))

        # Rigid glass trajectory. It never scales, rotates, or deforms.
        glass_center=None
        if 6<=i<=16:
            glass_center=(wrist[0],wrist[1]+30)
        elif i>=17:
            glass_center=(100,104)
        if glass_center is not None:
            frame=paste_glass(frame,sprite,origin,glass_center)

        frame=alpha_over(frame,finger_layer(wrist,opening))
        # As the object descends, the original basket face naturally occludes it.
        occ=0.0
        if 14<=i<=16: occ=smoothstep((i-13)/3)
        elif i>=17: occ=1.0
        frame=basket_foreground(frame,src,occ)
        frames.append(frame)

    out=np.stack(frames).astype(np.uint8)
    assert out.shape==(20,160,256,3)
    assert np.array_equal(out[0],src), \"Frame 00 must be pixel-identical\"
    return out
